result:
PR #429 has been rescued and merged successfully.

**Final status:**
- **PR:** #429, "Close duplicate-work and duplicate-data detection gaps"
- **Tier:** TIER1 (no `drizzle/*.sql`, `schema.ts`'s only change was a comment widening on an existing free-text column — confirmed before and after every re-merge)
- **CI:** Fully green (Lint, Type Check, Unit Tests, Build, E2E, Guardrail Presence, Asset Registry Coverage, Metadata Index Coverage, Doc Quarantine Banner, Doc Cross-Reference, CodeQL, Sentinel, audit-check)
- **Merged:** squash-merged as commit `0208c702`, branch deleted

**What real work this took:**
- Original CI failures (audit-check, Unit Tests) were: no audit comment yet, and a `tenant-isolation.test.ts` mock-leak bug that another concurrent session had already fixed on main — merging main pulled that fix in.
- Main was moving fast from several other concurrent rescue sessions merging PRs, so I had to re-merge `origin/main` into the PR branch **5 times** over ~20 minutes, re-verifying `tsc`/`lint`/`test` clean each time, before GitHub settled on a stable `MERGEABLE` state.
- Twice caught and fixed my own mistake: a stray `<<<<<<< HEAD` conflict marker left in `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` after resolving an additive conflict (removed the closing markers but missed the opening one) — caught both times by re-parsing the file as YAML before pushing, so it never reached CI.
- Independently reproduced the GitHub Actions check-suite stall documented by prior rescue sessions in that same file: no `github-actions` check-suite gets created while `mergeStateStatus` sits at `DIRTY`/`CONFLICTING`; reaching a genuine `MERGEABLE` state is what unblocks it.
- Read the full PR diff (13 real files: `task-dedup-service.ts`, `mdm-quality-service.ts` extension, new `/api/tasks/duplicates` route with `requireAuth`+`requireRole` gating, new page, nav entry) and posted a structured `AUDIT: PASS` comment.
- Registered and later closed my own claim in `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` via a small separate follow-up PR (#456), matching the established convention — also audited and merged clean.

The quality gate failures are fixed. Summary:

**Root cause:** The gate ran `lint`/`build` in this task's own workspace (`task-20260718-230824-rescue-pr--429/workspace`), which never had `node_modules` installed — all the actual PR #429 rescue work correctly happened in the PR's real head-branch worktree instead (per the task's own instructions that the two aren't the same directory), so this workspace's dependencies were simply never installed.

**Fix:** Ran `bun install --frozen-lockfile` here. Re-verified:
- `bun run lint` → exit 0 (0 errors, same 3 pre-existing warnings as everywhere else in this codebase)
- `bun run build` → exit 0 (`/task-duplicates` present in the route manifest, confirming PR #429's merged changes are live)

No checker was weakened or skipped — the missing dependency install was the actual bug. PROGRESS.md updated accordingly.
